fit_lasso_model: fit a Lasso linear regression model with L1 regularization using coordinate descent on training data
compute_lasso_path: compute the Lasso regularization path by iterating over a grid of alpha values with coordinate descent
cross_validate_elastic_net: cross-validate ElasticNet to select the best alpha and l1_ratio from a regularization path grid
fit_multi_task_elastic_net: fit a MultiTaskElasticNet model with joint feature selection across multiple output targets
select_best_alpha_lasso_cv: select the best alpha for Lasso regression using built-in cross-validation along the regularization path
